training_scope: 14 FAIB PSP plots in CWH northern Vancouver Island, with LidarBC CHM acquisition within 2 years of the plot visit. Responses use live trees DBH >= 9.1 cm; predictors are 11.28 m circular CHM metrics.
source: FAIB Forest Inventory Ground Plots (public PSP data, OGL-BC) and LidarBC 2023/2024 DEM+DSM CHM (OGL-BC); FEMIC fit 2026-10-29. Response definitions follow FEMIC INV-01 pilot; not a published model.

applicability.notes: Local CWH pilot fit. Nine additional plots with 4-6 year ground/LiDAR offsets were held out for a temporal stress test. Not calibrated for TSA 23 or operational use.

caveats: Local FEMIC pilot fit from 14 public FAIB PSP plots; this is not a province-wide ABA model.
The predictors are CHM proxies for first-return point-cloud metrics.
The 14 training plots and 9 temporal-offset plots are too few for an operational accuracy claim.
No independent P48/P49 field-plot validation was available.
Do not use outside CWH northern Vancouver Island without new calibration and validation.
